one_line: Players buy bowling gear, wear pro jersey/shoes, place bowling pins on the floor, and throw a heavy colorful bowling ball to knock pins (or standing people) down.
player_facing_mechanics: Wear bowling shoes for a movement speed boost (slowdown -0.3)
Wear the bowling jersey to enable 'pro' bowling power on thrown balls while a uniform is worn
Throw the bowling ball (range 150) with a spinning sprite and bowling sound
Ball gains 10% chance to knock down/knockback a standing carbon on impact even without pro jersey
Ball deals bonus effects on pin/kid hits: knockdown 60 and +15 brute (plus throwforce 10)
Ball knocks over placed bowling pins on crossing, playing a one-shot hit sound per throw
Place bowling pins on a clear floor tile via item interaction; they stand up with pixel offset and a glass sound
Standing pins topple when a non-flying mob larger than small crosses them, when a bowling ball crosses them, or when a dense object crosses
Pins topple if moved or picked up while standing
Commit suicide with the ball to launch yourself into a wall and gib
Buy a contraband 'Bowling Crate' from cargo containing 4 balls, 3 pin sets, and a margherita pizzabox
data_only_parts: bowling shoes stats (slowdown, description, icons, worn state)
bowling ball base stats (force, throwforce, throw_range, throw_speed, weight class, slot flags, body_parts_covered, inhand/worn icons)
bowling pins base stats (icons, name, description)
supply pack definition (cost CARGO_CRATE_VALUE*15, contraband flag, contained items)
random color palette list for balls
logic_parts: bowling_ball/throw_at override: carbon thrower check, spin sprite state, bowl sound, jersey/w_uniform pro_wielded check, target retargeting to edge turf, range 150, play_pin_sound_on_hit flag
bowling_ball/throw_impact: sprite reset, pro/10% proc, standing-carbon knockdown + 15 brute
bowling_ball/suicide_act + on_body_hit callback: throw self, gib user
bowling_pins/interact_with_atom: floor tile + no-density check, move, toggle standing
bowling_pins/toggle_standing: icon swap, pixel offset, register/unregister CROSS/MOVED signals
bowling_pins/on_entered handler: topple on mob movement (not airborne, size > small), topple on bowling_ball (calls knocked_pin), topple on dense obj
byond_specific: No verbs, client procs, browse(), topic calls, or external servers used
Relies on BYOND atom movement signals and icon/pixel rendering for spin and pin visuals
Depends on external DMI/sound assets under surfshack13/icons and surfshack13/sound
port_notes: An SS14 port would be mostly YAML prototypes: bowling ball/pins/shoes/jersey items plus a cargo crate (CargoProduct/Bounty or the trading/imports system), with the jersey/shoes being clothing prototypes granting a movement speed modifier and a 'pro bowl' tagging component. The interactive parts map to a ThrownItemComponent/throw-impact hook (or a custom BowlingBallSystem) that checks the thrower's worn uniform for a ProBowl marker, applies Knockdown + brute DamageSpecifier, and emits an impact sound; pins would be an entity with a placed/standing state using CollisionStart/Cross events (or a PinsComponent with a standing field and signal subscriptions) to topple and fire a one-shot sound. Design questions to answer: whether 'pro' should be a component flag vs. an item tag/marker on the jersey, how to model the single-per-throw hit-sound guard, whether to keep the suicide gib interaction, and tuning of the contraband cargo price and the 150-tile throw range.
